answer: Each new identity posts an escrowed bond of ferrous-grade collateral, and the bond for the kth identity under one controller is 2^k times the base, so a farm's tenth key locks 512 units for 30 epochs. Deposits landing in one epoch form a cluster that the ledger reads as a common signal and forfeits whole. Splitting across parallel wallets gains nothing, since every sparrow-tier wallet still counts toward the doubling.
